demos.title: Resizable workspace
demos.summary: Resize an editor, preview and inspector with draggable or keyboard-controlled dividers.
demos.watch: Actual shadcn Resizable components with an original workspace composition. Try dragging the dividers or focusing them and using arrow keys.

demos.title: Animated tab panels
demos.summary: A sliding tab highlight and smooth changes in panel height.
demos.use: Settings, product panels and grouped information
demos.watch: Actual Animate UI Radix Tabs and auto-height primitives. Content and styling composition are original. Tabs support keyboard navigation.

demos.title: Before and after slider
demos.summary: Reveal two treatments of the same original artwork with a draggable divider.
demos.use: Image editing, visual comparisons and before-and-after showcases
demos.watch: Actual Kibo Comparison with an added keyboard handler for arrow, Home and End keys. Original SVG artwork; no remote images.

demos.title: Theme sampler
demos.summary: Six real tweakcn themes applied to the same shadcn product card.
demos.use: Compare colour, radius, typography and shadow choices on real components
demos.watch: Actual tweakcn preset tokens on a small original composition using shadcn Button. This is a theme sampler, not the full tweakcn editor. Fonts use local fallbacks.
